title: A phase II, placebo-controlled, washout trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of AP707 in the treatment of Fibromyalgia syndrome (REPLACE-1)
official: A phase II, placebo-controlled, washout trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of AP707 in the treatment of Fibromyalgia syndrome (REPLACE-1)
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to evaluate the efficacy of AP707 in the treatment of participants with Fibromyalgia syndrome (FMS)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Able to understand the implications of their participation in the trial, able to understand the  directions, questions and instructions of the trial, and then signed and dated the informed  consent forms, and able and willing to comply with the protocol
2. 18 to 99 years old, and have a life expectancy of over 1 year, per investigator's judgement, at screening
3. Diagnosed with primary fibromyalgia syndrome as defined by the 2016 Revisions to the  2010/2011 Fibromyalgia Diagnostic Criteria by the American College of Rheumatology,  which are agreed by the German Pain Society. Accordingly, the participant must meet all  of the following criteria:  (1) Generalized pain, defined as pain in at least 4 of 5 regions, is present  (2) Symptoms have been present at a similar level for at least 3 months  (3) Widespread pain index (WPI) ≥ 7 and symptom severity scale (SSS) score ≥ 5 OR  WPI of 4–6 and SSS score ≥ 9  (4) A diagnosis of fibromyalgia is valid irrespective of other diagnoses. A diagnosis of  fibromyalgia does not exclude the presence of other clinically important illnesses
4. Having moderate to severe pain at screening defined as an average pain intensity ≥ 4 and  ≤ 9 on a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS, 0 – 10) during the last four weeks
5. Use of effective contraception methods (<1% failure rate) from screening to end of follow- up. This does not apply for persons of non-childbearing potential (i.e., post-menopausal,  surgically sterile or in a stable same sex relationship)
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of hypersensitivity or intolerance to the IMP or its ingredients or to ingredients of  similar chemical structure, including cannabinoids and cannabis products
2. Known liver disease or Alanine aminotransferase (ALT, GPT) or Aspartate  aminotransferase (AST, GOT) or Alkaline phosphatase (AP, ALP) level >2.5 x ULN or  bilirubin >1.5 x Upper Limit of Normal (ULN) at screening
3. Known kidney disease or serum creatinine > 1.5 x ULN or estimated glomerular filtration  rate <60 mL/min/1.73 m2 according to the Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology  Collaboration equation at screening
4. Body Mass Index (BMI) <18 or >40 kg/m2 at screening
5. Use of cannabinoids within 8 weeks before screening
6. Participating or participated in another interventional clinical trial within 4 weeks before  screening
7. Females who are currently pregnant or lactating, or persons who intend to become  pregnant during the trial
8. Investigator or personnel of the investigator site, the sponsor or involved service providers  and/or their immediate families, or the participant is considered to belong to a vulnerable  population (e.g., placed under guardianship or imprisoned)
9. Any medical or psychiatric condition which, in the investigator's judgement, would pose  them in risk, preclude the participant from adhering to the protocol or completing the  clinical trial per protocol
10. Any infectious or inflammatory disease, or neurological or psychiatric disorder, that in the  investigator's judgement, would confound or interfere with the participant's assessments  on their primary fibromyalgia syndrome
11. Diagnosis of severe depression or a DASS-21 depression score ≥ 21 at screening.  Participants are allowed to take only Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs) as  antidepressant, and they must have been on a stable therapy during the last 3 months at  screening, and their therapy will be maintained stable throughout the study
12. History of malignancy within the previous 5 years (except for basal cell or squamous cell  carcinoma of the skin that had been fully excised with no evidence of recurrence, or  treated carcinoma in-situ of the cervix)
